shots.title: Format decimal sprint currency deltas without floating-point noise (#513)
shots.notes: `slope map --check` now parses decimal current sprint ids and formats sprint currency labels/deltas through shared roadmap sprint formatting helpers.

shots.title: Add decimal sprint currency map-check regression (#513)
shots.notes: Added a map-check regression proving a 143.6 current sprint compared with a 143 map sprint prints `+0.6` and never the raw JavaScript floating-point artifact.

conditions.description: The first full-suite run exposed a Windows EPERM flake in the atomic-write lock test; raised as #515 and triaged into S143.95.
The full suite still emits unrelated Windows path noise from broader Node command redirection, already captured by #514 and planned for S143.9.

training.description: Decimal sprint ids should be parsed and formatted through shared roadmap helpers whenever user-visible sprint labels or deltas are emitted.
training.outcome: Map staleness output now reports clean sprint currency deltas for inserted decimal sprints.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/commands/map.test.ts` passed: 11 tests.
`corepack pnpm typecheck` and `corepack pnpm prepare` passed.
Branch-built `node dist/cli/index.js map --check` printed a clean decimal sprint currency delta without floating-point noise.
`corepack pnpm test` passed on rerun after #515 was triaged: 229 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3627 tests passed, 25 skipped.
#515 was filed and triaged into S143.95 before S143.8 closeout.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A precise formatting cleanup: small code surface, high confidence, and a useful regression at the CLI boundary.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When decimal sprint ids appear in arithmetic, format the resulting number before printing it.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The atomic lock flake surfaced only under full-suite contention, not the focused rerun.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S143.9 can finish the Windows stderr cleanup, then S143.95 can harden the lock path exposed during validation.

bunker_locations: Raw decimal subtraction can expose JavaScript floating-point artifacts in CLI output.
Atomic file-lock tests can hit transient Windows EPERM under full-suite contention.
yardage_book_updates: `src/cli/commands/map.ts` now uses shared sprint parse/format helpers for map sprint currency output.
`tests/cli/commands/map.test.ts` covers clean decimal sprint currency output for `map --check`.
course_management_notes: Issue #513 should close when the PR containing S143.8 merges.
Issue #515 is triaged into S143.95 before the release sprint.
